name: spartrak/module-wishlist
description: Wishlist support for the Spartrak storefront: a numeric item count on the wishlist customer-data section, so the header badge renders the numeral Figma draws instead of Magento's translated "N items" phrase, and the view model behind the wishlist page's product rows (Figma 817:18852) - the image role to draw and whether the product can still be bought.
